title: reset 三种模式对三区的影响
expected_output:
reset 三种模式对三区的影响（重置回上一个提交）
  --soft  : git status --porcelain 行数 = 1 ; 暂存区保留了 b.txt
  --mixed : git status --porcelain 行数 = 1 ; b.txt 退到工作区(未跟踪)
  --hard  : git status --porcelain 行数 = 0 ; b.txt 被彻底丢弃
  --soft  的 git diff --cached --stat:
     b.txt | 1 +
     1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)
结论: --soft 只动 HEAD；--mixed(默认) 还动暂存区；--hard 连工作区一起动（危险）
code:
import os, subprocess, tempfile, hashlib, pathlib

GIT_ENV = dict(os.environ)
for _k, _v in [("GIT_AUTHOR_NAME", "dev"), ("GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL", "dev@example.com"),
               ("GIT_AUTHOR_DATE", "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"),
               ("GIT_COMMITTER_NAME", "dev"), ("GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL", "dev@example.com"),
               ("GIT_COMMITTER_DATE", "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00")]:
    GIT_ENV[_k] = _v

def g(args, cwd):
    r = subprocess.run(["git"] + args, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, env=GIT_ENV)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("git %s failed:\n%s" % (args, r.stderr))
    return r.stdout

def new_repo():
    d = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="repo_")
    g(["init", "-q", "-b", "main"], d)
    g(["config", "user.name", "dev"], d)
    g(["config", "user.email", "dev@example.com"], d)
    g(["config", "commit.gpgsign", "false"], d)
    g(["config", "core.autocrlf", "false"], d)
    g(["config", "core.eol", "lf"], d)
    return d

def w(d, name, content):
    p = pathlib.Path(d) / name
    if isinstance(content, str):
        p.write_bytes(content.encode("utf-8"))
    else:
        p.write_bytes(content)

def blob_sha(content_bytes):
    b = content_bytes.encode("utf-8") if isinstance(content_bytes, str) else content_bytes
    h = hashlib.sha1()
    h.update(b"blob " + str(len(b)).encode() + b"\x00" + b)
    return h.hexdigest()


def demo(mode):
    d = new_repo()
    w(d, "a.txt", "1\n")
    g(["add", "-A"], d)
    g(["commit", "-q", "-m", "c1"], d)
    w(d, "b.txt", "2\n")
    g(["add", "-A"], d)
    g(["commit", "-q", "-m", "c2"], d)
    g(["reset", "--" + mode, "HEAD~1"], d)
    porc = len([l for l in g(["status", "--porcelain"], d).splitlines() if l.strip()])
    cached = g(["diff", "--cached", "--stat"], d)
    return porc, cached

ps, cs = demo("soft")
pm, cm = demo("mixed")
ph, ch = demo("hard")
print("reset 三种模式对三区的影响（重置回上一个提交）")
print("  --soft  : git status --porcelain 行数 = %d ; 暂存区保留了 b.txt" % ps)
print("  --mixed : git status --porcelain 行数 = %d ; b.txt 退到工作区(未跟踪)" % pm)
print("  --hard  : git status --porcelain 行数 = %d ; b.txt 被彻底丢弃" % ph)
print("  --soft  的 git diff --cached --stat:")
for l in cs.splitlines():
    print("    " + l)
print("结论: --soft 只动 HEAD；--mixed(默认) 还动暂存区；--hard 连工作区一起动（危险）")
